title: What are the store hours?
text: Store FAQ (General). What are the store hours? Lakeview Mall store: 10:30 to 21:30 every day.

title: Which payment methods are accepted?
text: Store FAQ (General). Which payment methods are accepted? UPI, credit and debit cards, net banking, and cash. No-cost EMI is available on cards for purchases above Rs. 6,000.

title: Do you offer gift wrapping?
text: Store FAQ (General). Do you offer gift wrapping? Yes, free gift wrapping and a greeting card at the billing counter.

title: Can I get a watch engraved?
text: Store FAQ (General). Can I get a watch engraved? Yes, on the caseback of steel watches. Rs. 600 ready in 4 days. Engraved watches cannot be returned.

title: Can I try a watch on?
text: Store FAQ (General). Can I try a watch on? Yes. Ask the kiosk to call a staff member, or speak to anyone at the counter.

title: Can you hold a watch for me?
text: Store FAQ (General). Can you hold a watch for me? Staff can hold an in-stock watch for up to 24 hours.

title: Can you transfer a watch from another store?
text: Store FAQ (General). Can you transfer a watch from another store? Yes. Transfers from other city stores take 3 to 4 days; from the warehouse, 4 days.

title: Do you deliver?
text: Store FAQ (General). Do you deliver? Home delivery within the city is free for orders above Rs. 2,400 and takes 3 to 5 days.

title: Do you buy or exchange old watches?
text: Store FAQ (General). Do you buy or exchange old watches? Through the old-watch exchange offer on Veyra Atelier only.

title: Are prices inclusive of GST?
text: Store FAQ (Buying and paying). Are prices inclusive of GST? Yes. The MRP on the tag and on the kiosk includes 18% GST. The invoice shows the GST amount separately.

title: Which EMI tenures are available?
text: Store FAQ (Buying and paying). Which EMI tenures are available? No-cost EMI for 3 or 6 months on major credit cards for purchases above Rs. 6,000. Longer tenures carry the bank's interest.

title: Can I pay partly in cash and partly by card?
text: Store FAQ (Buying and paying). Can I pay partly in cash and partly by card? Yes, a bill can be split between two payment methods at the counter.

title: Do I get a printed or digital invoice?
text: Store FAQ (Buying and paying). Do I get a printed or digital invoice? Both. The digital invoice is sent by SMS and email if you share a number or address at billing.

title: I lost my invoice. Can I get a copy?
text: Store FAQ (Buying and paying). I lost my invoice. Can I get a copy? Yes. Staff can reprint an invoice from the billing system using the phone number used at purchase.

title: What does pre-booking mean?
text: Store FAQ (Buying and paying). What does pre-booking mean? Some new models are listed for pre-booking before launch. You pay a Rs. 600 token amount, adjusted against the final bill, and the watch is held for you on launch day. The token is refundable until the launch date.

title: Can I reserve a watch online and pick it up here?
text: Store FAQ (Buying and paying). Can I reserve a watch online and pick it up here? Yes. Reserve-and-collect orders are held for 24 hours at the chosen store.

title: Can I be told when an out-of-stock watch arrives?
text: Store FAQ (Buying and paying). Can I be told when an out-of-stock watch arrives? Yes. Staff can register your number and you get an SMS when the watch reaches this store.

title: Do you sell gift cards?
text: Store FAQ (Buying and paying). Do you sell gift cards? Yes. Veyra gift cards from Rs. 600 to Rs. 30,000 valid for 12 months, usable at any Veyra brand store.

title: Can a gift card be used with a festive offer?
text: Store FAQ (Buying and paying). Can a gift card be used with a festive offer? Yes, a gift card is a payment method, so it can be used with any current offer.

title: Does every watch come with a box?
text: Store FAQ (Gifts and packaging). Does every watch come with a box? Yes. Veyra Atelier watches come in a wooden presentation box; other sub-brands come in a card gift box.

title: Can I get a gift receipt without the price?
text: Store FAQ (Gifts and packaging). Can I get a gift receipt without the price? Yes. Ask for a gift receipt at billing; it lets the recipient exchange the watch without showing the price.

title: Can the person I gift it to exchange it?
text: Store FAQ (Gifts and packaging). Can the person I gift it to exchange it? Yes, with the gift receipt or the invoice, within the normal 7-day exchange window.

title: How do I know which case size suits me?
text: Store FAQ (Sizing and fit). How do I know which case size suits me? See the size guide. As a rule of thumb, wrists under 15 cm suit cases of 28 to 36 mm, 15 to 17 cm suit 36 to 41 mm, and over 17 cm suit 41 mm and above.

title: Can a metal bracelet be shortened?
text: Store FAQ (Sizing and fit). Can a metal bracelet be shortened? Yes, free for Veyra watches in about 15 to 20 minutes. Removed links are returned to you in a small pouch.

title: Can a bracelet be made longer?
text: Store FAQ (Sizing and fit). Can a bracelet be made longer? Spare links can be ordered for most Veyra bracelets. They take 7 to 9 days and cost Rs. 200 to Rs. 500 per link.

title: Can I swap a leather strap for a metal bracelet?
text: Store FAQ (Sizing and fit). Can I swap a leather strap for a metal bracelet? Only where the case is designed for both. Staff can check whether a bracelet is available for your model.

title: What is lug width?
text: Store FAQ (Sizing and fit). What is lug width? The distance between the two lugs where the strap attaches, in millimetres. A replacement strap must match it.

title: How long does a battery last?
text: Store FAQ (Batteries and power). How long does a battery last? Usually 2 to 3 years on analog quartz watches and 1 to 2 years on digital watches with frequent backlight or alarm use.

title: How do I know the battery is low?
text: Store FAQ (Batteries and power). How do I know the battery is low? On many analog quartz watches the seconds hand starts jumping in 2- or 4-second steps. Digital displays fade or blink.

title: Do you replace batteries in other brands' watches?
text: Store FAQ (Batteries and power). Do you replace batteries in other brands' watches? Yes, for quartz watches, at Rs. 300 to Rs. 550. The store cannot guarantee water resistance after opening a non-Veyra watch.

title: How long does a solar watch run in the dark?
text: Store FAQ (Batteries and power). How long does a solar watch run in the dark? A fully charged Veyra solar watch runs for about 6 months in darkness.

title: How long does an automatic run when I take it off?
text: Store FAQ (Batteries and power). How long does an automatic run when I take it off? About 40 hours on a full wind. After that it stops and the time must be set again.

title: Do automatic watches need a battery?
text: Store FAQ (Batteries and power). Do automatic watches need a battery? No. They are powered by the movement of your wrist.

title: How do I set the date safely?
text: Store FAQ (Using your watch). How do I set the date safely? Avoid changing the date between 9 pm and 3 am on analog watches, when the date wheel is already moving.

title: What is a screw-down crown?
text: Store FAQ (Using your watch). What is a screw-down crown? A crown that screws into the case to keep water out. Always screw it back in fully after setting the time.

title: How do I use a chronograph?
text: Store FAQ (Using your watch). How do I use a chronograph? Press the top pusher to start and stop the stopwatch, and the bottom pusher to reset it. Do not press the pushers under water.

title: How do I set the alarm on a digital watch?
text: Store FAQ (Using your watch). How do I set the alarm on a digital watch? Press the mode button until the alarm screen appears, hold the adjust button to edit the hours and minutes, then press mode to save.

title: Does the backlight drain the battery?
text: Store FAQ (Using your watch). Does the backlight drain the battery? Heavy backlight use shortens battery life. Use it for a few seconds at a time.

title: What does dual time mean?
text: Store FAQ (Using your watch). What does dual time mean? The watch shows a second time zone, set separately from the main time.

title: Why does my watch gain or lose a few seconds?
text: Store FAQ (Using your watch). Why does my watch gain or lose a few seconds? Quartz watches are accurate to about plus or minus 15 seconds a month; automatics to about plus or minus 20 seconds a day.

title: Can I wear my watch in the gym?
text: Store FAQ (Care and safety). Can I wear my watch in the gym? Yes, but rinse metal, rubber and silicone straps after heavy sweating and keep leather straps dry.

title: Can I wear my watch in a sauna or hot shower?
text: Store FAQ (Care and safety). Can I wear my watch in a sauna or hot shower? No. Heat and steam can damage the seals of any water-resistant watch.

title: How should I store a watch I don't wear often?
text: Store FAQ (Care and safety). How should I store a watch I don't wear often? In its box, away from direct sunlight, magnets and damp. Solar watches should be stored face-up in light.

title: Why has my leather strap changed colour?
text: Store FAQ (Care and safety). Why has my leather strap changed colour? Leather darkens with skin oils, sweat and sunlight. This is normal wear and is not covered by the warranty.

title: Is the plating on gold-tone watches permanent?
text: Store FAQ (Care and safety). Is the plating on gold-tone watches permanent? Gold-tone and rose gold finishes are plated and can wear at edges over years of use. Plating wear is not covered by the warranty.

title: Do I need to register my watch for the warranty?
text: Store FAQ (Warranty and service). Do I need to register my watch for the warranty? No. The warranty starts from the invoice date automatically.

title: I lost the warranty card. Is my warranty still valid?
text: Store FAQ (Warranty and service). I lost the warranty card. Is my warranty still valid? Yes, the invoice alone is enough.

title: Can I claim warranty at another Veyra store?
text: Store FAQ (Warranty and service). Can I claim warranty at another Veyra store? Yes, at any Veyra brand store in India, with the invoice.

title: Does a battery replacement affect the warranty?
text: Store FAQ (Warranty and service). Does a battery replacement affect the warranty? Not if it is done at a Veyra store. Battery changes elsewhere void the water-resistance cover.

title: How long does a repair take?
text: Store FAQ (Warranty and service). How long does a repair take? Most warranty claims are assessed within 9 working days. Service times are listed in the service price table.

title: Can I track my repair?
text: Store FAQ (Warranty and service). Can I track my repair? Yes. You get a job card number and an SMS when the watch is ready to collect.

title: Is there parking at Lakeview Mall?
text: Store FAQ (Store visit). Is there parking at Lakeview Mall? Yes, the mall has paid parking for cars and two-wheelers.

title: Is the store wheelchair accessible?
text: Store FAQ (Store visit). Is the store wheelchair accessible? Yes. The store is on the ground floor with step-free entry.

title: Can I use the kiosk to find a watch and then see it?
text: Store FAQ (Store visit). Can I use the kiosk to find a watch and then see it? Yes. The kiosk can search the catalogue, check stock and call a staff member to bring the watch to you.

title: Which other Veyra stores are nearby?
text: Store FAQ (Store visit). Which other Veyra stores are nearby? Church Road (2.7 km, 11:00 to 21:00), Riverside Mall (7.4 km, 10:00 to 22:30) and the Clock Tower multi-brand outlet (11.2 km, 10:00 to 20:30).

title: Warranty policy
text:
Warranty policy
- **Movement warranty:** 24 months for Veyra Atelier and Veyra watches, and for all automatic watches. 12 months for Veyra Pulse, Veyra Nitya and Veyra Junior.
- **Battery warranty:** 12 months on quartz watches; 24 months on solar watches (rechargeable cell). Automatic watches have no battery.
- **Starts from:** the date on the purchase invoice. Keep the invoice and the warranty card; either digital or paper is accepted.
- **Covered:** manufacturing defects in the movement and battery.
- **Not covered:** straps and bracelets, glass breakage, scratches, water damage beyond the rated water resistance, damage from accidents or misuse, repairs by unauthorised service centres, and normal wear of plating.
- **How to claim:** bring the watch and invoice to any Veyra brand store. Most claims are assessed within 7 working days. Repaired or replaced watches carry the remaining original warranty or 3 months, whichever is longer.
- **Gifts:** a gift recipient can claim with the giver's invoice or the order number.

title: Returns and exchanges
text:
Returns and exchanges
- **In-store purchases:** exchange within 9 days with invoice, if the watch is unworn, all protective films are intact and the original box is included. Refunds are given only for manufacturing defects found within 9 days.
- **Online orders:** return within 17 days of delivery for a full refund, under the same condition rules.
- **Sale items:** items bought under a promotion can be exchanged but not refunded.
- **Engraved watches** cannot be returned or exchanged.
- **Discontinued models** can be exchanged for any watch of equal or higher MRP (pay the difference).

title: Service and repairs
text:
Service and repairs
| Service | Typical price | Time |
|---|---|---|
| Battery replacement (quartz) | Rs. 300 to Rs. 550 | 35 minutes in store |
| Bracelet resizing | Free for Veyra watches | 15 to 20 minutes |
| Strap replacement (leather) | Rs. 700 to Rs. 2,150 | Same day if in stock |
| Glass replacement (mineral) | Rs. 600 to Rs. 1,100 | 7 to 9 days |
| Automatic movement service | Rs. 4,200 to Rs. 7,200 | 4 to 5 weeks |
| Water-resistance test and reseal | Rs. 500 | 4 to 5 days |

- Automatic watches should be serviced every 4 to 5 years.
- Battery replacement within the battery warranty period is free.
- Book a service slot at any brand store or ask a staff member at the counter.

title: Watch care and water resistance: What the water-resistance rating means
text:
Watch care and water resistance: What the water-resistance rating means
| Rating | Suitable for | Not suitable for |
|---|---|---|
| 30 m (3 ATM / 3 bar) | Rain, splashes, hand-washing | Showering, swimming |
| 50 m (5 ATM) | Showering, light swimming in a pool | Diving, water sports |
| 100 m (10 ATM) | Swimming, snorkelling | Scuba diving |
| 200 m and above (20 ATM+) | Recreational scuba diving | Saturation diving |

The rating is a laboratory pressure test, not a depth you can safely dive to. Never press the buttons or pull the crown under water. Leather straps should never get wet regardless of the watch's rating.

title: Watch care and water resistance: Routine care
text:
Watch care and water resistance: Routine care
- Wipe the case and bracelet with a soft dry cloth; rinse metal and rubber straps in fresh water after sea or pool use.
- Keep watches away from strong magnets (speakers, phone cases with magnetic clasps), which can stop quartz movements or affect automatics.
- Avoid perfume and sanitiser directly on leather straps.
- Automatic watches wind themselves when worn; if unworn for more than about 40 hours they stop and need to be reset.
- Solar watches recharge under any light; leave them face-up near a window if they have been stored in a drawer.

title: Size guide: Case thickness
text:
Size guide: Case thickness
- Under 8 mm: dress watches that slide under a shirt cuff (Wafer, Wisp, Solenne).
- 8 to 12 mm: everyday watches.
- Over 12 mm: sports and dive watches, which feel heavier on the wrist.

title: Size guide: Measuring your wrist
text:
Size guide: Measuring your wrist
Wrap a strip of paper around the wrist just above the wrist bone, mark where it overlaps and measure the length with a ruler.

title: About Veyra Watch Co.
text:
About Veyra Watch Co.
Veyra Watch Co. is a fictional Indian watchmaker used for this prototype. It sells through brand stores, partner outlets and its website.

title: About Veyra Watch Co.: Sub-brands
text:
About Veyra Watch Co.: Sub-brands
- **Veyra Atelier** (premium): premium automatics and sapphire-crystal dress watches. Price range roughly ₹14,000 to ₹58,000.
- **Veyra** (flagship): the core range for office, occasion and sport. Price range roughly ₹3,500 to ₹16,000.
- **Veyra Pulse** (youth): bold, colourful watches for students and young professionals. Price range roughly ₹1,200 to ₹6,500.
- **Veyra Nitya** (value): dependable everyday watches at accessible prices. Price range roughly ₹650 to ₹3,200.
- **Veyra Junior** (kids): durable, easy-to-read watches for children. Price range roughly ₹500 to ₹1,800.

title: Analog
text: Watch glossary. Analog: shows the time with hands on a dial.

title: Digital
text: Watch glossary. Digital: shows the time as numbers on a display.

title: Ana-digi
text: Watch glossary. Ana-digi: has both hands and a digital display.

title: Quartz
text: Watch glossary. Quartz: a battery-powered movement controlled by a quartz crystal; very accurate and low-maintenance.

title: Automatic
text: Watch glossary. Automatic: a mechanical movement wound by the motion of the wrist; needs no battery.

title: Solar
text: Watch glossary. Solar: a quartz movement charged by light through the dial.

title: Chronograph
text: Watch glossary. Chronograph: a watch with a built-in stopwatch, operated by pushers beside the crown.

title: Multifunction
text: Watch glossary. Multifunction: extra small dials for day, date and 24-hour time.

title: Day-date
text: Watch glossary. Day-date: shows both the day of the week and the date.

title: Moonphase
text: Watch glossary. Moonphase: a small window showing the current phase of the moon.

title: Small seconds
text: Watch glossary. Small seconds: the seconds are shown on a small separate dial.

title: Open heart
text: Watch glossary. Open heart: a cut-out in the dial that shows part of the moving balance wheel.

title: Sapphire crystal
text: Watch glossary. Sapphire crystal: very scratch-resistant glass used on Veyra Atelier watches.

title: Mineral glass
text: Watch glossary. Mineral glass: hardened glass, more scratch-prone than sapphire; used on most Veyra and Veyra Nitya watches.

title: Acrylic glass
text: Watch glossary. Acrylic glass: light plastic glass used on kids' and digital watches; scratches can be polished out.

title: ATM / bar
text: Watch glossary. ATM / bar: units of water resistance. 1 ATM is about 10 metres, so 5 ATM equals 50 m.

title: Lume
text: Watch glossary. Lume: luminous paint on hands and markers that glows in the dark after exposure to light.

title: 316L stainless steel
text: Watch glossary. 316L stainless steel: a corrosion-resistant steel used on Veyra Atelier cases.

title: Titanium
text: Watch glossary. Titanium: a light, strong, hypoallergenic metal about 40% lighter than steel.

title: Tonneau
text: Watch glossary. Tonneau: a barrel-shaped case.

title: Bezel
text: Watch glossary. Bezel: the ring around the glass; on dive watches it rotates to time a dive.

title: Crown
text: Watch glossary. Crown: the knob used to set the time and date.

title: Lugs
text: Watch glossary. Lugs: the arms of the case that hold the strap.

title: Mesh strap
text: Watch glossary. Mesh strap: a fine woven metal strap with an adjustable clasp.

title: FKM rubber
text: Watch glossary. FKM rubber: a durable rubber used on dive straps.
